solution.description: All Riccati families v' = A v^2 + B v + C (v transcendental over a differential field containing A, B, C): A is a constant root of 2A^2 - bA - a; then (1) b != 2A, 3A: constant coefficients (d <= 1); (2) b = 2A (hence a = 0, the boundary) and c = -eA after B -> 0: W' = eW + g*, cards Q21-RIC-AIRY, Q21-RIC-EXPBESSEL; (3) b = 3A (hence a = -A^2, class P) and c = -eA: the projectivised linear equation, card P231-L3.
